scan.summary: This is the OLCC recreational marijuana Producer license (Tier II, Indoor) for Evergreen Botanicals' Bailey Hill site, authorizing cultivation up to a 10,000 sq ft mature canopy under ORS 475C and OAR chapter 845, division 25. It is the agency's own document, so there is nothing in it to fix; what matters to the business is renewing on time, keeping the five listed conditions in force, and displaying the license at the premises. The current term runs March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027.
scan.freshness_note: This is the current term of the license, issued March 3, 2026 and valid through March 2, 2027. It is not stale, but the annual renewal window (20 days before expiration, i.e. by roughly February 10, 2027) should be tracked now so it is not missed.

conditions.title: Operate only at the named premises; license is not transferable
conditions.evidence_expected: No change in location or ownership without prior OLCC approval; premises diagram on file matches 2210 Bailey Hill Road.

conditions.title: Renew annually at least 20 days before expiration
conditions.evidence_expected: Copy of submitted renewal application and fee receipt dated on or before February 10, 2027 (20 days before March 2, 2027); confirmation of 'complete' status from OLCC if relying on continued-operation privilege.

conditions.title: Track all marijuana items in CTS (Metrc) and ensure every handler holds a current worker permit
conditions.evidence_expected: CTS/Metrc account records and transaction logs; roster of employees handling marijuana items with current OLCC Marijuana Worker Permit numbers and expiration dates for each.

conditions.title: Maintain video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 and keep recordings at least 90 days
conditions.evidence_expected: Camera system documentation showing coverage of canopy and ingress/egress areas, retention logs showing at least 90 days on-site (and 30 days off-site backup), and any notices filed with OLCC if recording was ever stopped.

conditions.title: Report any change in ownership, premises, or financial interest holders before it takes effect
conditions.evidence_expected: Copies of any change-of-ownership or premises-modification notices filed with OLCC prior to the change, and OLCC's acknowledgment or approval.

conditions.title: Display the license at the licensed premises where the public can see it
conditions.evidence_expected: Photo or walkthrough note confirming the license is posted visibly at Bailey Hill.

deadlines.title: Annual renewal application and fee due at least 20 days before expiration
deadlines.source_line: "A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date."

facts.affects: Caps how much mature canopy can be grown at Bailey Hill under this Tier II indoor producer license; exceeding it would be an unlicensed activity.

facts.affects: Determines which OAR division 25 producer rules (canopy size limits, indoor-specific requirements) apply to this site.

facts.quote: recordings kept for at least 90 days
facts.affects: Sets the minimum on-site video retention the company must maintain to avoid a surveillance violation.

facts.value: every employee handling marijuana items must hold a current OLCC marijuana worker permit
facts.quote: every employee who handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission
facts.affects: Requires the company to verify and track individual worker permits before letting staff handle plants or product.

expected_missing.title: CTS/Metrc access and reporting records
expected_missing.why: Condition 3 requires all marijuana items tracked in the state system; operators typically retain login/user access lists and periodic reconciliation reports.
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Video surveillance system documentation and camera placement diagram
expected_missing.why: OAR 845-025-1450 compliance is usually evidenced by a plot plan/camera diagram plus retention logs, which pairs with Condition 4.
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Pesticide and agricultural chemical use log
expected_missing.why: Indoor cannabis producers in Oregon are typically also subject to pesticide-use rules (OAR 845-025-2070) and keep application logs even though this license does not mention it.
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Local city/county business license or fire/building inspection sign-off
expected_missing.why: OLCC premises approval is usually paired with local business licensing and fire/life-safety inspection records for the same address.
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

I am not certain whether a propagation endorsement or other add-on privileges apply to this specific site, since the license text does not mention one.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
